# Plain SDK ancestry and input interface covariance

The plain SDK return-slot profile adds a nongeneric input interface result
`Base`, its input implementation `Leaf` and an original covariant getter.
The consumer has no class Signature and extends the unchanged SDK widget.
An owned Code edit adds the original bridge's exact nominal interface upcast
without changing descriptors, flags or complete declaration metadata.

Run `test_mobile_android_plain_sdk_return_slots.py --interface-covariance`.
The immutable wrapper compares typed, erased, input-interface and reflected
calls, null results, mutable aliases, method ownership and state before the
same failure object. An independent concrete subclass is compiled against
original classes only. A changed result cast is rejected by the common bridge
proof. All original entries and full metadata recompile; original bridge body
and source-name projections remain disclosed as partial coverage.

Ten input classes and twenty-four methods retain their runtime inventory. The
wrapper adds 140 identity checks, seventy state observations and ten ordered
failures to the scalar/reference oracle. One original covariant bridge and
three source aliases remain explicitly reported as partial projections.
